Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the above title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Ahmed El-Beyaliy, tested by 
eng. Saad Shawky Atalla, accepted by general manager eng Saad Ibrahem Kheder 
and approved by eng. Abd El-Moatey El-Rakaiby head sector of Mahmoudia PS. This 
document revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar , certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil 
general manager of quality control & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay head sector of inspection and quality control.

Blower, digital 
 voltmeter mugger devices
Fine cloth for cleaning 
 purposes
Work to be carried out
